description: This is a Java source file defining the 'MavenWrapperDownloader' class, which handles downloading the Maven wrapper JAR using properties specified in a configuration file or a default URL.

classes.name: MavenWrapperDownloader
classes.description: Provides functionality to download the Maven wrapper JAR based on properties or a default URL, used by the Maven wrapper script.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method invoked by the wrapper script; initializes paths based on arguments, creates directories, loads the wrapper URL, and downloads the wrapper JAR.

methods.name: loadWrapperUrl
methods.description: Loads the wrapper URL from the properties file if it exists, otherwise returns a default URL.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads the JAR file from the specified URL to the destination path.
